summary: Rajesh Damani acquired 43.93 lakh shares of Jamshri Realty from his parents, promoters Premratan and Bimladevi Damani, through an off-market gift transfer without consideration.

headline: Jagsonpal Services seeks approval for ₹10 crore RPT
summary: Jagsonpal Services Limited has initiated a postal ballot to seek shareholder approval for a ₹10 crore business transfer agreement with related party Elanistech Private Limited.

headline: Digilogic Systems wins Best Manufacturing Award 2026
summary: Digilogic Systems Limited received the Best Manufacturing Company Award 2026 at the MSMECCII Make in India Initiative Awards for its contributions to defence and aerospace.

headline: Vedavaag Systems subsidiary gets IRDAI approval
summary: Vedavaag Financial Insurance Broking Services Private Limited received in-principle approval from IRDAI to act as a Direct Insurance Broker for Life and General insurance.

headline: Jyoti Resins lists on NSE from Oct 8
summary: Jyoti Resins & Adhesives Limited equity shares will be listed on NSE effective October 8, 2026. The company already trades on BSE.

headline: AXISCADES promoter releases 27,000 pledged shares
summary: Jupiter Capital Private Limited released 27,000 equity shares of AXISCADES Technologies from pledge with TATA Capital on October 6, 2026.

headline: Nivaka Fashions CFO and ED resigns
summary: Mitesh Ajit Thakkar resigned as CFO and Executive Director of Nivaka Fashions Ltd effective October 7, 2026, citing professional commitments.

headline: Pudumjee Paper sells MITCON Solar stake for ₹2.40 crore
summary: Pudumjee Paper Products Limited has executed a Share Purchase Agreement to sell its entire equity stake in MITCON Solar Alliance Limited for ₹2.40 crore, exiting the captive solar power venture.

headline: Blue Pearl Agriventures appoints new CS
summary: Blue Pearl Agriventures Limited appointed Neeraj Ramashankar Yadav as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective October 7, 2026.
